Eur. 6.2 (Aluminium Phosphate Gel; Aluminii Phosphatis Li- quamen). It is aluminium phosphate in gel form containing 19 to 21% of AlPO4. Practically insoluble in water, in alcohol, and in dichloromethane. It dissolves in dilute solutions of mineral acids. pH 6.0 to 8.0. Store in airtight containers. USP 31 (Aluminum Phosphate Gel). A 4 to 5% suspension of aluminium phosphate (AlPO4) in water and has a pH of 6.0 to 7.2. It is a white viscous suspension from which small amounts of water separate on standing. Store in airtight containers. Profile Aluminium phosphate is an antacid with general properties sim- ilar to those of aluminium hydroxide (p.1706), but it does not produce phosphate depletion. Aluminium phosphate is also used as an adjuvant in adsorbed vaccines. Preparations USP 31: Aluminum Phosphate Gel.
